title: 第11章 你还敢去丽春院要钱这么头铁第12章 卖艺不卖身我不给钱不就行了
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“你的意思是说，你一晚上就能赚十万枚灵石？”
面对神霄的质疑，沈浪深吸一口气道：
“我知道一夜的时间就赚这么点，的确有点少！”
“但我现在就是一个小衙役，想赚太多，风险太大了！”
“娘子，若是十万枚灵石不够，你家先帮我垫上，我保证到时候连本带利的还给你们！”
眼见沈浪不像是开玩笑，神霄人麻了。
她原本以为自己找沈浪要一万灵石，都算是心黑了。
没想到沈浪竟然张嘴就要给十万。
而且还是一夜之间就能赚到。
这使得神霄忽然间觉得，她的心还不够脏！
完全无法理解，一个贪官的思维。
“我能问问，你打算怎么赚吗？”
沈浪眯起眼：“自然是去找丽春院要了！”
“啥玩意？”神霄一脸的难以置信：“你现在还敢找丽春院要钱？”
“为啥不敢？”沈浪挑眉。
神霄：“……”
“你是不是觉得你的头足够的铁，想试试他们的刀，能不能砍死你？”
眼见神霄似乎不理解自己的操作，沈浪也是孤傲道：“放心吧，他们不敢杀我的！”
“给我个理由，否则我不会让你去的！”神霄板起脸道。

沈浪见状，也是眯起眼道：“其实我敢去找丽春院要钱，主要是因为小冉那个小呆逼从丽春院杀出来了。”
“你这是啥逻辑？”神霄一脸的茫然：“小冉从丽春院杀出来，你就敢去要钱了？”
“哎呀，跟你说了你也不懂，你这婆娘就别问了，坐等收钱就行了！”
眼见沈浪又不耐烦了，神霄张了张嘴，最终还是没有再多说什么。
因为，此刻的她，也想要看看，被仙人点化过的沈浪，到底有多少本事。
能否有资格跟北冥书院的夫子，过招？！
……
一个时辰后。
丽春院外的虚空内。
上官冉看着一身衙役装扮的沈浪，来到了卖她的那个小院之外，脸上也是浮现出了笑容：
“我就知道陛下把我喊回来，肯定是为了给我报仇！”
“只是，您让沈浪自己去丽春院卖，咱们怎么收钱呀？”

"You mean you can earn 100,000 spirit stones in one night?"
Facing Shen Xiao's doubts, Shen Lang took a deep breath and said:
“I know it’s really a little little to earn so much in one night!”
"But I am just a small government servant now. If I want to make too much money, the risk is too great!"
"Madam, if 100,000 spirit stones are not enough, your family can help me fill it in first, and I promise to return it to you with interest when the time comes!"
Seeing that Shen Lang didn't seem to be joking, Shenxiao became numb.
She originally thought that she had a dark heart when she asked Shen Lang for ten thousand spirit stones.
Unexpectedly, Shen Lang opened his mouth and asked for 100,000 yuan.
And you can make money overnight.
This made Shen Xiao suddenly feel that her heart was not dirty enough!
It is completely impossible to understand the thinking of a corrupt official.
"Can I ask, how do you plan to make money?"
Shen Lang narrowed his eyes: "Of course I went to Li Chun Yuan to get it!"
"What the hell?" Shen Xiao looked in disbelief: "You still dare to ask Li Chun Yuan for money now?"
"Why don't you dare?" Shen Lang raised his eyebrows.
Shen Xiao: "..."
"Do you think your head is strong enough and want to try their knives to see if they can kill you?"
Seeing that Shen Xiao didn't seem to understand his operation, Shen Lang also said arrogantly: "Don't worry, they don't dare to kill me!"
"Give me a reason, otherwise I won't let you go!" Shen Xiao said with a serious face.
When Shen Lang saw this, he also narrowed his eyes and said, "Actually, I dare to go to Li Chun Yuan to ask for money, mainly because that little idiot Xiao Ran came out of Li Chun Yuan."
"What's your logic?" Shen Xiao looked confused: "Xiao Ran came out of Lichun Courtyard, and you dare to ask for money?"
"Oh, even if I tell you, you don't understand. You bitch, just stop asking, just sit back and wait to receive the money!"
Seeing that Shen Lang was getting impatient again, Shen Xiao opened his mouth, but in the end he didn't say anything more.
Because, at this moment, she also wanted to see how capable Shen Lang, who had been enlightened by the immortal, was.
Are you qualified to compete with the Master of Beiming Academy? !
…
An hour later.
In the void outside Lichun Courtyard.
Shangguan Ran looked at Shen Lang, dressed as a government servant, outside the small courtyard where she was sold, and a smile appeared on his face:
"I knew that His Majesty must have called me back to avenge me!"
"It's just that if you let Shen Lang go to Lichun Courtyard to sell it by himself, how will we collect the money?"
